title: Lena and the Cover
author: Hazel Winterbourne
blurb: Jonah Ravensworth, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
